facts.fact: 梯子事件：怀胎的 Harriet 站在摇摇欲坠的人字梯上够顶层——Brooks 冲过去扶梯、自己搬下全部豆子罐头；「No ladders」命令。
facts.anchor: What I don’t expect is to find my pregnant sister atop a stepladder, leaning so far across the shelves that the ladder is beginning to wobble precariously.

facts.fact: Harriet 的自白上：爱 Dean、Emmy、腹中宝宝爱到想哭想炸（或想尿——宝宝压着膀胱）；孩子们是她此生全部想要的。
facts.anchor: I love my babies so damn much. They’re all I’ve ever wanted out of life.

facts.fact: Harriet 的自白下：「妈妈」这个身份吞没一切、抹掉之前的全部——她只是累了。
facts.anchor: But being Mom takes over everything, it erases everything that ever came before it, and I just… I’m tired, you know?

facts.fact: Ashton 的援手：带 Emmy 出去一天——烘焙、骑马、进城捣乱，让 Harriet 干自己需要的事；Brooks 补一句 sleep。
facts.anchor: Let me take Emmy for a day, huh?

facts.fact: 交接承诺：Ashton 收下 Harriet 的规则清单（无巧克力/无刺青/远蜜蜂/头盔护膝）——把 Emmy 的 EpiPen 和自己的放在一起。
facts.anchor: I’ll keep her EpiPen with mine. She’s safe with me, Harriet. I promise.

facts.fact: 虾塔可闪回：她十四岁那年 Heath 的 taco truck——没人点虾她却一口即发；Jody 对店主爆发，Ev 在人行道抱她用 EpiPen；Brooks 一边捏拳一边怕到想吐——「怕因一只虾塔可失去她」。
facts.anchor: None of us ordered shrimp, but Ashton took one bite and reacted immediately.

facts.fact: 记忆封锁：这段记忆创伤到他一直屏蔽至今——直到 Ashton 说「我可是没忘」。
facts.anchor: Apparently, the memory is so traumatic I’ve managed to block it out until now.

facts.fact: Ranch Wednesday 仪式：宽敞厨房装满笑声、家家带来家人——他搬出父母家后仍把这一晚当头等事；有 Ashton 在家更甜。
facts.anchor: Ranch Wednesdays are the best—the spacious kitchen is filled with all kinds of laughter, people bring their families along, and it’s always been my favorite night of the week.

facts.fact: girl talk 门口：她叉臂顶胯拦他——像少年时嫌他们烦的姿势，只是更美更聪明更 sassier；他笑着想起她挡卧室门看爱情片的旧影。
facts.anchor: She looks just like she did in her teens, when she was sick of us boys, but even more beautiful now she’s older and smarter, and somehow even sassier.

facts.fact: 拦门战：他答「我是纯爷们，小恶魔」——她鼻翼一缩倒吸冷气；「Then nope」弹了 P 音，全场女士憋笑。
facts.anchor: “I’m all man, little devil,” I answer with a smug smile and a raise of my eyebrows.

facts.fact: 金枪鱼爆料：几个月前她问过店家说只是金枪鱼——十秒后几乎无法呼吸；幸运是买了带回家才咬、EpiPen 就在手边——她一直没告诉任何人。
facts.anchor: Well, I asked, and they said it was just tuna, so I didn’t think I had to worry.

facts.fact: Brooks 的四重怒：恨自己忘记、恨卖三明治的人、恨自己不知情、恨不能立刻把她搂进怀里护她周全——胸口紧到呼吸困难。
facts.anchor: I’m furious at myself for forgetting, especially having seen firsthand how serious her allergy is and how severely it affects her. I’m furious at whoever made and sold Ashton that sandwich. I’m furious that I didn’t know

facts.fact: 妈妈的条件：回家期间约 Doctor Joe 查一查——顺带测普通鱼类的过敏（过敏会凭空发展）；她答应打电话。
facts.anchor: Will you make an old lady feel better by making an appointment with Doctor Joe while you’re home?

facts.fact: Harriet 的恳求：受不了这两位天天念叨「过马路看两边」——求她毕业后回家。
facts.anchor: And I can’t take these two whining about hoping you’re looking both ways before crossing the mean city streets all the time, so please, for the love of god, come home when you’re done with school?

facts.fact: 定音句：Mama Tanner 说——这不是严厉也不是温声，是笃定：愿你幸福，也愿你知道随时回来都欢迎。
facts.anchor: This is your home, Ashton,” Mama Tanner says. The words come with certainty—it’s not a stern reminder, but not really a gentle one, either. “We want you to be happy. And to know that you’re always welcome whenever you’re ready to come back.”
